_comment: Character models (prototype). Each body keeps the mannequin as an invisible animation driver; the model listed here copies its pose through an IK Retargeter (Tools/build_retargeters.py builds IK_<key> and RTG_Manny_<key> in /Game/WWO/Retarget; rerun it after adding a model). Keys: the flora ids for the player, allies and the character preview, and soldier / swarm / tank for the enemies. scale: the model's size against the mannequin it follows (1 = as authored). hide_slots: material slots to hide (the Paragon heroes' own guns, Kallari's trailing cloth tentacles). grafts: show the procedural flora grafts on the model (they're pinned to the mannequin's bones, so they sit where its body would be). Packs come from Fab (see HANDOFF) and are not in git. Edit and restart the game; no build needed unless you add a model (then rerun the script). models_off: entries parked here are ignored, so those bodies show the plain mannequin (2026-11-11: the three Paragon hero models cost about 2 ms of GPU a frame with 11 players in view on an M4; move an entry back into models to use it again). retargeter: use another key's RTG_Manny_<key> (the three floras share the robot frame, /Game/WWO/Characters/RobotFrame, built by Tools/import_robot_frame.py). fp_hide_bone / fp_body_back: your own model in first person is shown from this bone down (default spine_02) and set this many cm behind the camera (default 22), so you see your legs. hand_fingers / hand_palm: for a model whose hands are rigid (no finger bones), the way its right hand's fingers point and its palm faces in the reference pose (mesh space: x left, y forward, z up); the first-person hands then lay the hand flat against the gun. shells: the model wears swappable shell parts (the robot frame): its mesh is replaced by the bare skeleton, /Game/WWO/Characters/RobotFrame/Shells/SK_RobotSkeleton, and a head, core, arms and legs mesh from any shell (SK_Shell<n>_<Slot>, Tools/import_shell_parts.py; shell 0 is the base robot's own armour) play on its pose; wwo.Shell / -WWOShell= pick the shell for testing. player_mesh: a skeletal mesh on the mannequin's skeleton that players and bots wear instead of the mannequin (empty or missing = the mannequin).
